AADSM Reaches Milestone Number of Dentists Qualified in Oral Appliance Therapy

Sep 14, 2026 | Academies & Associations, Oral Appliances | 0 |

The growing network aims to expand patient access to local, trained providers of oral appliance therapy for obstructive sleep apnea.

Key takeaways:

  • The AADSM has reached a milestone of 2,500 dentists who have achieved qualified status to provide oral appliance therapy for obstructive sleep apnea.
  • The credential requires completing standardized education in dental sleep medicine that aligns with evidence-based practice standards.
  • Qualified providers are now located across all 50 states, Puerto Rico, and Washington, DC, promoting a team-based approach with physicians.

0:00 / 1:45
Instaread

The American Academy of Dental Sleep Medicine (AADSM) recently shared that 2,500 dentists across the country have achieved AADSM Qualified Dentist status, strengthening patient access to oral appliance therapy (OAT) for obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).

“Reaching 2,500 AADSM Qualified Dentists is an important milestone for patients who need convenient access to high-quality care close to home,” says Paul Jacobs, DDS, DABDSM, president of the AADSM, in a release. “Obstructive sleep apnea is a serious condition, and oral appliance therapy can be a comfortable and effective option for many patients. By expanding the number of qualified dentists available nationwide, we are helping more people connect with the care they need in their own communities.”

AADSM Qualified Dentists complete standardized education in dental sleep medicine that aligns with the academy’s evidence-based standards for practice. These dentists are trained to provide OAT in coordination with physicians, supporting a team-based approach to treating OSA.

For patients, the growing network means more opportunities to receive care from a dentist in their area. The AADSM emphasizes local dental care because OAT requires a custom-fit device, follow-up visits, adjustments, and ongoing monitoring to help ensure comfort and effectiveness.

There are now AADSM Qualified Dentists in all 50 states, Puerto Rico, and Washington, DC.
